messages:
maria (People Ops): Hey all :wave: Quick ask — hiring ops wants a tiny 90-day goal + manager-check-in pack that we can paste into offer emails and onboarding docs. Needs to be concise (one-liners for ICs + manager prompts + a few self-review bullets). Can anyone share a quick set for eng & product hires?

james (Eng Manager): I have a short version i use. Will drop it here, mostly bullets. :rocket:

sara (People Ops): Love that — if you include a version that fits into a single email paragraph even better.

james (Eng Manager): Copyable templates below — made for both IC and manager, plus a tiny self-review checklist. Use as-is or tweak.

james (Eng Manager): ```
90-day outcome-focused goal template (single line for offer/onboarding)
- Engineering IC: "Deliver a production-quality iteration of [feature/component] that reduces [measurable pain] by X% and is monitored in prod."
- Product IC: "Ship the MVP of [feature] that validates [hypothesis] with N qualitative user interviews and M quantitative metrics."

Week-by-week highlights (short bullets to expand in onboarding doc)
- Weeks 1-2: Ramp on codebase, ship a small bugfix or doc change, join core meetings.
- Month 1: Deliver first PR with automated tests; complete pairing with 2 team members.
- Month 2: Lead design/PR for a small scoped workstream; own a metric dashboard.
- Month 3: Ship iterated feature, collect user feedback, and present a short demo to the team.

Manager 1:1 / check-in prompts (first 90 days)
- Week 1: "What are you unclear about? Where do you need context or connections?"
- End of Month 1: "Which parts of the stack still feel opaque? What small wins do you want to secure next?"
- Month 2: "What blockers are slowing your delivery? Who should we connect you with?"
- Month 3: "What would success look like for your next 6 weeks? Any changes to goals?"

Self-review micro-lines (for first 90-day checkpoint)
- "Took ownership of [feature], shipped X, and verified with Y metric/user feedback."
- "Built relationships across [team(s)] and paired on key areas to speed onboarding."
- "Identified a reliability/UX gap and proposed a prioritized fix that reduced incidents/complaints."

Manager note: keep feedback concrete, link to PRs/metrics, and give 1 area to focus next quarter.```

alex (Software Engineer): This is gold — for eng hires i usually add a tiny safety-first bullet: "demonstrate a runbook read + ability to reproduce a recent incident locally" — helps with ops onboarding.

tess (Product Manager): For product folks, swap "PR" with "spec" and add "conduct at least 5 user interviews" to month 2.

sara (People Ops): Nice. Can you also give a 1-paragraph email-friendly version? Hiring ops wants something <3 lines we can paste under "what success looks like" in offer packets.

james (Eng Manager): Sure — one-paragraph bits below, two variants (eng/product).

james (Eng Manager): ```
Email snippet (Engineering): In your first 90 days, you'll ship a production-ready iteration of [feature/component], own its monitoring and alerts, and collaborate closely with two teammates to accelerate delivery. We'll check progress at 30/60/90 days with concrete examples (PRs, metrics, demos).

Email snippet (Product): In your first 90 days, you'll define and ship an MVP of [feature], run initial user interviews, and set measurable success criteria. We'll sync at 30/60/90 days on outcomes, learnings, and next milestones.
```

sara (People Ops): Perfect — exactly what hiring ops needs. I'll add these to the offer template and onboarding checklist.

maria (People Ops): Amazing, thanks everyone :heart: One last ask — can we add 3 quick one-liners managers can paste into a calendar invite for a 30/60/90 review?

james (Eng Manager): Yup — drop them here.

james (Eng Manager): ```
30-day invite line: "30-day check-in — quick sync to unblock ramp and confirm early priorities (15-30m)."
60-day invite line: "60-day review — demo progress, feedback on collaboration, and adjust scope for next sprint (30-45m)."
90-day invite line: "90-day checkpoint — summarize outcomes, set next milestones, and discuss growth plan (45-60m)."
```

alex (Software Engineer): quick nit: add expected prep for the hire (e.g., bring three examples of work or a short demo).

tess (Product Manager): also call out who should attend (manager + onboarding buddy + cross-functional PM/EM as relevant).

sara (People Ops): Will assemble final pack: (1) 1-line offer snippets, (2) 90-day goal bullets, (3) manager check prompts, (4) self-review micro-lines, (5) invite lines, (6) prep notes for candidate. All set to put into hiring docs.

maria (People Ops): Thank you! If anyone wants to tweak wording for IC level seniority (L2 vs L5), DM me and i'll maintain two variants in the repo. :tada:
